environment.note: The probe compares two published MCP schema.json revisions and asserts, symbol by symbol, that the JSON-RPC types the changelog says were REMOVED are absent and the ones it says were ADDED are present. This is a deterministic $defs-membership check — no timing, no model interpretation — so CPU/GPU/RAM do not affect the result and are intentionally omitted.

subject.name: Model Context Protocol specification — 2025-11-25 stable vs the 2026-07-28 release-candidate draft
subject.note: The 2025-11-25 axis is a frozen, published revision. The draft axis is a mutable snapshot taken 2026-07-27 (one day before the RC's 2026-07-28 publish).

baseline.name: 2025-11-25 stable revision
baseline.note: The previous stable protocol revision. The comparison is by observed schema symbol presence/absence, tying each changelog claim to a concrete $defs symbol.

fixture.design: 20 assertions each map a changelog claim (statelessness: initialize/ping/setLevel/subscribe removed; Tasks moved to an extension; server/discover, cacheable results, subscriptions/listen, MRTR, new error types added) to a specific $defs symbol expected to be present in exactly one of the two revisions.

raw_artifacts.retention_policy: schema snapshots NOT committed — schema-2025-11-25.json (174 KB) + schema-draft.json (180 KB) exceed the repo's 100 KB per-run size budget, and the draft is a moving target. run.sh re-fetches both from GitHub raw.
raw_artifacts.note: The deterministic evidence — probe-result.json (20/20 assertion matrix + the full removed_defs/added_defs lists) — is committed. Re-running run.sh fetches the CURRENT draft, so the draft-axis symbols may drift from the 2026-07-27 snapshot; that drift is expected and is part of the finding (see the honest-limits section). The 2025-11-25 axis is frozen and stable.
